topic: What happens if you swim in the Dead Sea?
title: Dead Sea Float
hook: What if you jumped into the Dead Sea?

beats.line: The water is about ten times saltier than the ocean.
So you float like a cork, even if you can't swim.
It's the lowest place on land, about four hundred thirty meters below sea level.
One drop in your eye stings so badly, swimmers rush for fresh water.
And every tiny cut on your skin burns like fire.

end.line: Would you float in the Dead Sea?

description: Ten times saltier than the ocean: why you can't sink in the Dead Sea, and why it stings.

facts.claim: The Dead Sea is about 34% salt, roughly ten times saltier than the ocean.
The high density of the water makes people float easily.
Its shore is the lowest land on Earth, about 430 m below sea level.
Dead Sea water in the eyes or in cuts causes strong stinging; swimmers are told to rinse with fresh water.
facts.source: Israel Ministry of Tourism - Dead Sea safety
